df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check if the trial was randomised by comparing baseline characteristics between arms
# Cross-tabulate arm with other variables to check balance

# Check balance of sex
df.groupby(['arm', 'sex']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Check balance of age
df.groupby('arm')['age'].mean()

# Check balance of severity
df.groupby(['arm', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)"}
